key_provisions_or_claims: Amends Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 annexes listing harmonised machinery standards under Directive 2006/42/EC
Adds new and revised EN standards (cranes, industrial trucks, presses, mining machines) conferring presumption of conformity
Publishes EN 474-1:2006+A6:2019 with restriction on quick couplers for excavators and backhoe loaders due to injuries
Defers withdrawal of superseded standards to 15 April 2023
annotation.summary_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1813 amends the list of harmonised standards supporting the Machinery Directive 2006/42/EC, adding new standards for cranes, industrial trucks, presses and mining machinery, restricting EN 474-1 over quick-coupler injuries, and deferring withdrawal of superseded standards.
annotation.title_clean: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1813 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 as regards harmonised standards for aircraft ground support equipment, cranes, mining tools, and other machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC and repealing Implementing Decision (EU) 2015/27
annotation.title_en: Commission Implementing Decision (EU) 2021/1813 amending Implementing Decision (EU) 2019/436 as regards harmonised standards for aircraft ground support equipment, cranes, mining tools, and other machinery drafted in support of Directive 2006/42/EC and repealing Implementing Decision (EU) 2015/27
